label: Confirmed Deaths
contestNote: Toll rose steadily from 2 (15 Aug) to 73 (19 Aug) to 83 (21 Aug) to 87 (22 Aug) as rescue teams reached remote villages; BNPB says earlier additions were largely indirect earthquake impacts (shock, falls, aftershock-triggered cardiac events) rather than structural-collapse fatalities.

label: Injured
contestNote: BNPB's 22 August tally cites 1,298 injured (336 seriously), up from the reconciled 986 figure reported 21 August; the injured count has swung both up and down across reporting days as regency-level tallies are reconciled.

label: Displaced / Sheltering
contestNote: Figures climbed from 92,735 (20 Aug) to 110,785 (21 Aug) to 150,576 (23 Aug, 06:00 WIB) as assessments reached isolated communities; Manggarai Timur regency alone accounts for 31,372 evacuees, the highest of any regency.

label: Homes Damaged
contestNote: BNPB's 22 August verified tally of 53,971 (19,006 severe, 11,777 moderate, 23,188 slight) supersedes the 44,946 figure reported the day before; Manggarai Timur regency has the single largest share at 17,039 damaged homes. Figures remain preliminary pending by-name-by-address verification, complete for six of eight regencies as of 22 August.

label: Aftershocks Recorded
deltaNote: M1.1–M6.2 range, 124 felt by residents as of 22 August (up from 4,258 on 21 August); some outlets report a higher running count around 5,688. BMKG's forecast of continued activity for 21–30 more days from the mainshock is unchanged.

label: Mainshock Magnitude
contestNote: GFZ Potsdam measured Mw 7.61 at 25 km depth vs. USGS/BMKG's M7.7 at 10 km; BMKG's own first report was M7.0 before revising upward.
